name: MonarchMethodBadge
title: MethodBadge
summary: An HTTP method label (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) in the code typeface, with a tone per method.
whenToUse: In endpoint lists, API references and request logs, before the path of a request.
whenNotToUse: For a status or other metadata use MonarchBadge. For the release stage of an API use MonarchLifecycleBadge.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMethodBadge(method: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone? = null)
object MonarchMethodBadgeDefaults { fun toneFor(method: String): MonarchTone }

options.name: method
options.description: The HTTP method in any case. It is trimmed and shown in upper case.

options.name: tone
options.description: Replaces the tone chosen from the method. null keeps GET success, POST info, PUT and PATCH warning, DELETE danger and everything else neutral.

states.name: default
states.description: Not interactive; one look per tone.

appearance: A tinted fill of the tone with strong text and a border of the tone, in 6dp corners; the neutral tone is the muted background with muted text and no border. Every pair comes from one tone family, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map named MonarchBadge as the base. MonarchBadge is a capsule in the caption role and cannot take the code typeface or a minimum width, so this component draws its own surface from the same tone palette, as iOS does. The web's sm and md sizes are not offered: the text is the code role (14sp) and follows the font size setting. The web's tone type has no accent; MonarchTone is used. The tone map is MonarchMethodBadgeDefaults.toneFor, the web's methodTone and iOS's tone(for:).
accessibility: Read by TalkBack as the method name, which is always the visible text, so color is never the only signal.
The text grows with the font size setting and the 56dp minimum width grows with it.
Not interactive: it has no click action and no touch target.
edgeCases: A method outside GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE is neutral, including HEAD and OPTIONS.
An empty method draws an empty badge at the minimum width.
A long method wraps inside the badge; real methods are one word.
With a custom code font family in monarchTypography, that family is used.
